agent_explanation: Emergency preemption at t=51 interrupts the normal cycle without respecting yellow/all-red. At step 48 NS is green, steps 49-50 NS is yellow (only 2s of required 6s), then at step 51 the controller immediately switches to EW green to serve the emergency on E, with 0s of all-red (need 1s). The emergency handler appears to force the demanded direction green instantly, bypassing the required yellow completion and all-red clearance insertion.
